title: Sky Rush – Free Sky Jumping Game | Play in Browser, Android & iPhone
desc: Sky Rush is a free arcade jumping game: hop from platform to platform into the sky, outrun the storm and win live 4-player duels. Play instantly in your browser – no sign-up.
lead: Hops jumps all by himself – you just decide where. Tap or swipe, grab coins, dodge drones and leave the storm behind.
play_note: In your browser · no sign-up · no download
what: Sky Rush is a free arcade jumping game by ITpaul – a mix of Doodle Jump and Subway Surfers. Your character jumps automatically from platform to platform while you switch lanes by tapping, swiping or tilting. The goal: get as high as you can before the storm below catches up. Sky Rush runs right in your browser and as an app for Android and iPhone.
feats: From the city rooftops through clouds, auroras and outer space into hyperspace. A Sky Gate awaits every 10,000 m.
Race players from around the world or invite friends with a room code – with time races, knockout mode and collisions.
Tap, swipe or tilt, portrait or landscape. Easy to learn, hard to master.
Jetpacks, wings, hats and faces. Aurum, Platina and Kristallo are only for true high flyers.
Daily Run, weekly tournament, a 100-tier season path and global leaderboards.
No paid loot boxes, open odds, and every record is verified on the server.
modes: Jump as high as you can – your record counts on the global height leaderboard.
The same course for everyone, every day: one try, one leaderboard.
One week, one course, several tries. Who gets highest?
Up to four players live on one course – quick match or your own room with your own rules.
how: Left or right switches lanes. Swipe up for a double jump, swipe down to drop through a platform.
Coins and stars charge your RUSH: super jumps, magnet and double coins.
A storm is rising below you and it keeps getting faster. Keep moving!

faq: Yes. Sky Rush is completely free to play. There are optional reward videos and optional purchases (coin packs, starter pack, remove ads). Ad breaks only appear between two runs.
Which devices does Sky Rush run on?
Sky Rush runs right in the browser on phones, tablets and computers at {{HOST}} – no download needed. In the browser you can also add it to your home screen as an app.
No. Sky Rush starts instantly, without sign-up or email address. You just pick a player name.

Yes. In Duel mode up to four players race live. Invite friends with a room code and choose a time race (1 to 5 minutes), knockout with only one life, or collisions. Offline you can train against bots.
Yes. Endless mode and training against bots work without internet. Leaderboards and live duels need a connection.
Are there loot boxes or pay-to-win?
No. Chests and the wheel only contain in-game items, cannot be bought, and their odds are shown in the game. Every record is verified on the server – cheating gets you nowhere.
Sky Rush is developed by ITpaul, an independent developer from Germany.
Which languages is Sky Rush available in?
In 11 languages: German, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Polish, Indonesian, Japanese and Korean.
